project_type: Node/Express + vanilla JS PWA (Polish gift-list app), static assets in public/, no frontend build step; Playwright e2e boots the real server in demo mode
language: JavaScript (Node v24 locally; engines >=16), plain CSS, HTML
build_system: No app build. CSS tooling is devDependencies only: postcss 8, postcss-cli 11, @fullhuman/postcss-purgecss 4.1.3, cssnano 7 via postcss.config.js. No npm script builds public/styles.deduped.min.css today. Deploy (Dockerfile npm install --only=production, render.yaml npm install, vercel.json -> server.js) never builds CSS, so generated CSS must stay committed. Windows + PowerShell: chain with ';' not '&&'. Working tree is CRLF (core.autocrlf=true, no .gitattributes), git blobs are LF: normalise CRLF->LF before hashing/parsing/building and preserve each file's EOL when editing.
test_framework: @playwright/test 1.61.0 with channel 'msedge' (installed Edge 154/155), workers 1, demo server on a free port (tests/global-setup.js), serviceWorkers blocked, CDN files cached in tests/.cache/cdn (git-ignored; copy from P/tests/.cache if missing). Specs in tests/e2e/*.spec.js (smoke, wrapping, no-horizontal-overflow, a11y, composer-*, edit-sheet, chat-reactions, escaping, helpers, pluralization, xss-usernames).
build_command: node scripts/build-css.js (to be added in FEAT-002 as npm run build:css); there is no other build
test_command: npm test  (full suite, ~8-10 min, expected 121 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped); canary: npm run test:e2e -- smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y
verification_instructions: After every CSS-changing step: node .agents\tasks\tmp-css-snapshot.js "$env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\snap-<label>" then node .agents\tasks\tmp-css-compare.js .agents\tasks\css-baseline <that dir>. B and C: zero diffs. D: only .container overflow-x hidden->clip and overflow-y auto->visible (--allow overflow-container) plus zero rect diffs. See css-plan.md sections 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/styles.deduped.min.css is GENERATED/derived from public/styles.css by postcss.config.js (PurgeCSS+cssnano) but is currently OUT OF SYNC and hand-patched (probe: 290 identical rules, 13 changed, 65 only committed, 29 only regenerated; :root --ios-success #00693E vs #34c759). Never hand-edit it; it may change only through scripts/build-css.js and only if the zero-diff snapshot proof passes. Committed snapshot baseline: .agents/tasks/css-baseline/*.json (56 files) + .agents/tasks/tmp-css-snapshot.js (commit e939a28), never overwrite.
environment_constraints: Never git push, never cr. Stage files by name. Do not touch tests/, server code, JS logic, package-lock.json. Do not change <link rel=stylesheet> order on any page. Evidence/snapshot dirs go to $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1 (outside repo); temp scripts are untracked .agents/tasks/tmp-css-*.js. Previous workflow noted activity page data is clock-relative: if only activity element counts differ, re-baseline from the phase-start commit in a temp worktree instead of masking. Another workflow may be running a Playwright suite concurrently (each suite uses its own port, only slower). Parent workspace P = c:\Users\matmamon\OneDrive - amazon.com\Documents\Prezenty\prezenty, worktree W = P\.worktrees\css-consolidate-1.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits (imperative, subject <=50 chars, body explains why, no sim footer since no SIM exists). Commit early and often, one commit per concern so D and each C file are individually revertable. Conservative rule everywhere: when evidence is not conclusive KEEP the rule. sw.js CACHE_NAME 'prezenty-v125' -> 'prezenty-v127' ONCE at the end (max(127, main/sibling value + 1)); bump ?v= on every linked CSS whose bytes changed; keep urlsToCache consistent. Deliverable docs (committed, in W/.agents/tasks): css-audit.md, css-dead-rules-removed.txt, css-consolidate-1-verification.md; plus public/CSS-README.md and scripts/build-css.js.
key_patterns: Pages link CDN sheets first, then styles.deduped.min.css (all pages except leaderboard=raw styles.css, intro/maintenance=none), optional aws-design.css (activity, recipients), bottom-tab-bar.css?v=42, app-theme.css?v=14, filters.css?v=7 (recipients), chat-reactions.css?v=3 (wiadomosci), <page>-page*.css?v=1 last. styles.css is ~15.5k lines with ~1,771 exact duplicate rules (probe). .container{overflow-x:hidden} is at styles.css ~1400 and ~7044 and inside the minified deduped file. server.js sends Cache-Control no-cache for css/js; sw.js is cache-first for non-HTML keyed by full URL incl. ?v. tests/helpers/{pages,cdn-cache,start-demo-server}.js are reused by the snapshot harness.
relevant_files: W/.agents/tasks/tmp-css-snapshot.js (harness to study and extend by copy)
W/tests/e2e/*.spec.js and W/tests/helpers/*.js (read-only, to replay interactions)
directory_structure: public/ = served static root (html, css, js, images); routes/, lib/ = server code (read for class-name strings only); scripts/ = node utility scripts (init-db etc.; build-css.js goes here); tests/ = Playwright suite (read-only); .agents/tasks/ = task docs, baseline, temp tooling; docs/ = project docs; .worktrees/ = sibling worktrees (ignored via .git/info/exclude).
